name: ARMOR-UPDATER
role: Detects, installs and updates the A.R.M.O.R. ecosystem's repositories on the machine it runs on
stack: Python 3.10+ (standard library only; PySide6 optional for the desktop shell)
technologies: GitHub REST API and raw content
deployment_target: Any machine that installs or updates A.R.M.O.R. repositories (a developer PC or the central server)
notes: Manifest discovery, version comparison, and an atomic-by-verification install/update (a build is verified in an isolated staging clone before being promoted, never in place). Every A.R.M.O.R. repository is private, so remote discovery and manifest fetches require a GITHUB_TOKEN throughout (there is no unauthenticated fallback), and the manifest reader matches A.R.M.O.R.'s own armor.project.json shape (free-text role/deployment_target, a flat native_version string). Not yet run against a real private repository end to end.
